text: Its not a hit test. the hit lights up perfect. see [Image #1]
resolution: Fixed the selected-face versus edit-target mismatch in the Buildings stage. Stage click selection now maps the raycast hit normal to a face slot and calls a new store-level selectPieceTarget action, which selects the piece, sets the active face row, and repoints the material browser/paint target to that clicked piece face. Added a regression test where a stale roof material target is replaced by a clicked wall-front target before applying, proving the wall changes and the roof keeps its material.
